description: This file contains unit tests for the Feign-based Fineract client, verifying builder configurations, client instantiation, and API accessibility.

classes.name: FeignClientSmokeTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the Feign client setup and API access in the Fineract project.

methods.name: getTestUrl
methods.description: Constructs the test URL using system properties and configuration defaults.

methods.name: testFeignClientBuilder
methods.description: Tests the creation of a FineractFeignClient builder with the specified base URL and credentials.

methods.name: testFeignClientConfig
methods.description: Tests the creation and validity of the FineractFeignClientConfig object with debugging enabled.

methods.name: testFeignClientCanInstantiateApis
methods.description: Verifies that the Fineract client and its API components can be instantiated successfully.
